# Vendor Assessment Notes - 2026-Q4

## Halcyon Data Systems

- Vendor ID: VND-1042
- Account owner: Priya Raman
- Last assessment: 2026-09-14
- Primary risk: single-region hosting without a documented failover contract.

The analytics warehouse is the primary store for customer segmentation data. The vendor completed the SOC 2 bridge letter on schedule.

## Meridian Cloud Labs

- Vendor ID: VND-1177
- Account owner: Tomas Herrera
- Last assessment: 2026-08-02
- Primary risk: the SOC 2 boundary excludes the analytics sub-processor.

Managed hosting is stable and capacity alarms are reviewed weekly. The sub-processor exclusion was raised during the previous cycle.

## Cobalt Freight Analytics

- Vendor ID: VND-1204
- Account owner: Ingrid Solberg
- Last assessment: 2026-07-21
- Primary risk: two high-severity findings remain open in the latest report.

Telemetry data powers the live routing dashboard. Remediation work is tracked jointly with the vendor's engineering team.

## Bluefin Ledger Services

- Vendor ID: VND-1310
- Account owner: Kofi Mensah

Accounts payable processing touches bank account data. The vendor has not engaged an independent auditor for the current period.

Badge production runs on a fixed quarterly schedule. Data handling practices are described in the statement of work.
